subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood x CloudBridge — next steps
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Solutions Team <solutions@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood x CloudBridge — next steps
Attachments: cloudbridge-integration-overview.pdf

Hi Marissa and team,

Great to meet you all on the call this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps from CloudBridge's side: 

- Use case alignment: customer-facing knowledge retrieval + in-app summarization (primary), batch embedding migration (secondary).
- Integration considerations: Marketplace listing (CloudBridge AMI) + SSO/KMS requirements were flagged by the security team.
- Success criteria: sub-200ms tail latency for 512-token requests, reasonable unit cost via caching/quantization recommendations.

Our ask: schedule a partner-led technical deep dive/demo with Redwood's runtime and your solutions engineers. Proposed slots (all PT):

• Tue Aug 4 — 10:00–11:00am PT
• Wed Aug 5 — 1:00–2:00pm PT

If those don't work, happy to take alternatives. I'm attaching a short integration overview that the CloudBridge solutions team put together.

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

Best,
Samir Kapoor
Channel Partner Manager
CloudBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: Redwood x CloudBridge — next steps

Thanks Samir — great recap. Mateo and I reviewed the notes and those success criteria make sense. We're excited to coordinate the technical deep dive.

I can do Tue Aug 4 10:00am PT — that works for me. Mateo, can you lead the demo and bring one of our runtime engineers to cover latency/quantization tradeoffs?

A few quick asks so we can scope the session:
- Can CloudBridge share a short list of the target customer workloads (avg seq len, QPS, expected concurrency)?
- Any compliance artifacts needed for the marketplace listing (SOC 2 snippets, KMS usage notes)?

Attaching our partner playbook for reference. I'll send a calendar invite after we confirm attendees.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
